title: Overpayment Refunds on Insurance Claim Repairs Repair Orders — Desk Reference
content:
## When a refund is due

When the customer's payments and credits on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order exceed its customer charges and the refunds already made, the excess is refunded against one payment and goes back to that payment's method within the class's refund processing business days. The refund names the payment it returns and goes back to that payment's method.

**Timing.** An overpayment is not refunded until every customer-pay addition consent issued on the repair order stands signed or revoked.

In other words, while any customer-pay addition consent issued on the repair order still stands awaiting the customer, no overpayment refund is made on it.

| Customer-pay addition consents issued on the repair order | Overpayment may be refunded |
|---|---|
| none issued | yes |
| every one issued stands signed or revoked | yes |
| at least one still stands awaiting the customer | no |

## Capability

The tool refunds part or all of one customer payment on a repair order where the customer has paid more than the repair order owes. One refund entry is recorded against the named payment, dated today, for the amount given and to the same payment method as that payment; the repair order's customer balance rises by the refunded amount, and the customer sees the money returned to their card, bank account or by check according to the original payment.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `issue_overpayment_refund_b142d0d2`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_repair_id` | reference number of the Insurance Claim Repairs repair order the refund is made on, as the repair order lookup returns it | identifier, as returned |
| `source_entry_id` | reference number of the customer payment entry the refund returns, as the repair order money history lookup returns it | identifier, as returned |
| `amount_usd` | the amount refunded | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount; further digits are rounded half to even to the cent before it is recorded |

## Return

A receipt with:

- `refund_entry_id` — reference number of the refund entry;
- `claim_repair_id` — the repair order;
- `source_entry_id` — the payment returned;
- `amount_usd` — the amount refunded, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `payment_method` — the method the money goes back to: card, ach, cash, check or financing;
- `entry_date` — the refund date, YYYY-MM-DD.

A receipt carrying a `refund_entry_id` confirms the refund is recorded.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** Repair order CR-4001, payment entry PM-17 (a card payment) and USD 200.00 return a refund entry reference, the same repair order and payment, USD 200.00, the method card and today's date.
